'''Sun Ruyong''' ({{zh|s=孙儒泳|p=Sūn Rúyǒng}}; 12 June 1927 – 14 February 2020) was a Chinese ecologist.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://new.qq.com/omn/20200214/20200214A0MK1S00.html?pc |script-title=zh:著名生态学家孙儒泳院士逝世 |work=Tencent |date=14 February 2020 |access-date=15 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref> He was a member of the Ecological Society of China and served as its president between November 1987 and October 1991.

==Biography==
Sun was born in [[Ningbo]], [[Zhejiang]], on June 12, 1927. In September 1940, he attended the Ningbo County Private Three-One Middle School ({{lang|zh|宁波县私立三一学校}}).<ref name="tomato"/> On October 27, 1940, the Japanese [[Unit 731]] dropped a bacterial bomb on the downtown area of Ningbo, and the [[Plague (disease)|plague]] broke out suddenly, killing more than 100 people in just ten days.<ref name="tomato"/> On April 19, 1941, the [[Imperial Japanese Army]] occupied Ningbo, and the school was forced to disband.<ref name="tomato"/> In 1942 he was accepted to Ningbo Normal High School ({{lang|zh|宁波高中师范学校}}), where he met Li Pingzhi ({{lang|zh|李平之}}), a music teacher who had a profound impact on him.<ref name="tomato"/> After graduation, due to the [[Nationalist government]] not recognizing his education background, he had to wait for work at home.<ref name="tomato"/> With the help of Li Pingzhi, he then taught at Shanghai Tangshanlu School ({{lang|zh|上海唐山路小学}}).<ref name="tomato"/> In 1949, he enrolled at [[Beijing Normal University]], majoring in the Department of Biology. After graduating in 1951, he taught at the university as an assistant. He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] in 1952. After a year's study at Beijing Russian Institute, he was sent to study at [[Moscow State University]], where he obtained a [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree under the supervision of Haymob.{{cn|date=July 2024}} He returned to China in 1958 and continued to teach at Beijing Normal University, where he was promoted to associate professor in 1978 and to full professor in 1984. In October 1983, he led the team to Belgium for academic research. He died of [[myocardial infarction]] in [[Guangzhou]], [[Guangdong]], on February 14, 2020, aged 92.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://tech.sina.com.cn/roll/2020-02-15/doc-iimxyqvz2973074.shtml |script-title=zh:孙儒泳院士逝世 |work=sina |date=15 February 2020 |access-date=15 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="tomato">{{cite news|editor1=Sheng Yuqing ({{lang|zh|盛雨晴}})|url=http://3g.163.com/news/article/F5CDR9JD0550AXN7.html |script-title=zh:生态学家孙儒泳院士去世，曾说离开生态学也就没有了生命 |work=163.com |date=14 February 2020 |access-date=15 February 2020 |language=zh}}</ref>
